_comment: Ad Hoc Session A3 -- built-in starter flag bundles for optimizer.py's --preset flag. Not a config format for user-saved presets (those live in the frontend's cloud-synced preset store, a separate mechanism) -- this file is the CLI's one-shot starting point for the three lineup types Greg builds: Cash, SE/3-Max GPP, and MME GPP (20-150 lineups). Any flag explicitly passed on the command line overrides the matching value here (see main()'s _load_preset_overrides()). lambda values are the validated defaults from Session 10.5b's backtest sweep (DK, 2018-2021, 65 weeks, holdout) -- see optimizer.py's --lambda help text and ROADMAP.md Ad Hoc Session A5. [UPDATED 2026-09-26: cash and se_gpp now use lambda=0 -- an 88-slate 2021-25 replay found 0.063 loses ~5 lineup pts vs 0 in all 6 seasons; see HANDOFF_fc_history_ownership_findings_2026-09-26.md. Original text follows.] Cash and se_gpp use lambda=0.063, the grid's best value for their own metric (cash beat@p44 +0.006 over 0.0, <1 SE, suggestive not conclusive; se_gpp/3-max beat@p50 also best at 0.063 but no clear winner over 0.0). mme_gpp uses lambda=-0.005, the grid's best value for large-field top@p90, where any positive lambda measurably hurts. mme_gpp's dart-exposure-cap/dart-floor-threshold (Ad Hoc Session A6, 2026-09-13) are a heuristic guard, NOT a swept/backtested value like lambda -- see optimizer.py's --dart-exposure-cap help text for the real Week 1 example (Kevin Austin Jr., a $3,000 near-zero-floor filler) that motivated it. Not added to se_gpp/cash: with only 1-3 lineups there's no meaningful 'exposure' to spread a dart across in the first place.

cash._comment: 2026-09-30 (WK3_POSTMORTEM_OPEN item 5): --cl-* classic construction soft terms, same weights in all four classic presets. Evidence: HANDOFF_classic_lineupstudy_findings_2026-09-29.md, 410 real DK classic contests / 21.9M entries 2022-2026; full write-up in CLASSIC_RULES.md. The shape findings were Supported similarly across SE/3MAX/20MAX, and unlike the SE3max-only 'lean chalkier' ownership finding they are not contest-type specific, so no per-preset split. Point scale = 1 cash-lift pt ~ 1 projected pt, the showdown_se/showdown_gpp convention. zero-punt 1.5 uses the §5 projection-controlled '>=1 punt' coefficient (+1.4 to +1.9) instead of the raw -1.9 to -2.3. The other terms have no controlled coefficient, so their raw lifts are shaded x0.75 (the zero-punt controlled/raw ratio) to allow for overlap with projection: DST $2.8-3.1k band +0.8 (raw +0.8/+1.2/+1.2), DST $3.6k+ -2.0 (raw -2.3/-2.8/-2.9), 3+ punts -2.5 (raw -2.7 to -4.7, flat once), FLEX RB / FLEX WR flat terms stay ZEROED 2026-10-02 (were +0.6 / -1.0 from raw lifts): a projection-controlled re-fit (analysis/flex_position/, 381 contests, FLEX dummies vs a TE baseline + the FLEX player's own proj/salary/ownership) found RB vs TE is ~0 at every FLEX salary tier (never a real effect, so flex-rb-bonus stays dead) and WR vs TE is price-dependent: ~0 pooled, but a real penalty at mid price ($4,900-$6,300) and a real, large bonus at high price ($6,300+). See CLASSIC_RULES.md rule 3. cl-flex-wr-highprice-bonus 3.0 / cl-flex-wr-midprice-penalty 1.3 are the controlled replacement (shaded to the low end of each controlled range, same convention as the other terms here): WR >= $6,300 beats TE by +2.8 to +4.1 points / +3.9 to +6.1 cash pts, 4/4 seasons, SE/3MAX/20MAX all pass; WR $4,900-$6,300 is a real downgrade vs TE, -1.3 to -1.5 points / -1.6 to -2.0 cash pts, passes in SE and 20MAX (3MAX trends the same direction but doesn't individually clear). Sanity check (analysis/classic_shape_weights/, 9 real 2026 wk1-3 DK classic slates, se3max_pool structure, 20 paired 5%-randomized seeds each = 180 pairs vs the same build with the terms off): always feasible; shape moved as intended (DST in band 16%->63%, $3.6k+ DST 25%->2%, 0-punt 19%->4%, 3+ punts 13%->0%, FLEX WR 15%->0%); projection cost -0.9 pts/lineup; real percentile +0.030 (slate-level SE 0.052, 4 of 9 slates better), top-25% cash rate 29.4%->23.9%. Mixed and inside noise: not harmful on percentile, not a proven win. The unshaded set (1.0/2.5/1.5/3.0/0.8/1.3) gave the same result at a -1.1 projection cost. These are first-pass point-scale conversions, not a swept optimum: re-check against real Wk4+ classic results. [UPDATED 2026-10-05, Wk4 construction review: cl-three-plus-punt-penalty 2.5 -> 0.5. Projection-controlled history re-fit (analysis/wk4_construction_review/history_controlled_checks.py, 353 FC classic contests, section-5 controls + punt-count dummies vs 1 punt) puts 3+ punts at +0.4 cash / -0.35 pts (CIs span 0, every format) -- the raw -2.7 to -4.7 was a projection confound; 2026 real DK fields Wk1-4 had 3+ punt lineups +8.5 raw / +6.6 controlled cash pts, 9/13 contests positive. 0.5 keeps a mild nudge at the controlled points estimate. See CLASSIC_RULES.md rule 2.] [UPDATED 2026-10-05 (FLEX-WR drill-down, analysis/wk4_construction_review/RESULTS_flex_wr.md): cl-flex-wr-highprice-bonus 3.0 -> 0. As implemented the bonus fires on ANY 4-WR lineup holding a $6.3k+ WR -- 92% of real 4-WR lineups qualify -- so the solver collects it by adding a cheap 4th WR (10/12 2026 pools flipped to 4-WR, -1.4 projected pts, added WR often $3-4.4k). DK FLEX-slot placement is close to random by price (cheapest WR in FLEX 35%, priciest 24%), so the history slot finding does not translate to that lineup property. Live UI builds never had it on anyway (worker allowlist bug, fixed same day), so 0 matches what the owner actually built with. midprice penalty 1.3 kept (only fires when every extra-WR candidate is $4.9-6.3k, ~inert).]

mme_gpp._mme_settings_verify_2026-10-03: analysis/mme_settings_verify/ (35 slates: 3 real 2026 MME + 32 rebuilt history, graded ceiling-first per owner: best-of-pool percentile/top-1%-hit/$ROI, not mean cash rate). bring-back true vs false: inconclusive, mixed direction (percentile +0.020 but $ROI -9.6, CIs span 0) -- KEPT true. randomization-pct 18 vs 10: every ceiling metric trended positive and none trended negative (best-lineup pts +2.3, percentile +0.016, top-1% +0.01, cash +2.5pts) though CIs are thin (n=35, 1 seed/arm) -- CHANGED 18->10 on owner's call to act on a one-sided signal under a lock deadline rather than wait for a tighter CI. Caveat: part of the projection gain at lower randomization is mechanical (less injected noise = higher raw EV almost by construction), and the pool used ~57 unique players vs ~70 at randomization 18 -- watch actual exposure/diversity on real batches, since less player variety across the 20 entries cuts slightly against the point of a 20-lineup spread. max-exposure 0.50 tested WORSE (best-lineup pts -3.9) -- stays 0.35. Re-test randomization 10 vs 18 on the full 64-slate history set with 3+ seeds when there's time; not urgent.

showdown_se._comment: WK3 postmortem §2/§3 (2026-09-28, updated 2026-09-29 after a real-slate sanity check): the Showdown single-entry/Huddle counterpart to se_gpp. --stack-mode is intentionally omitted -- optimizer.py rejects it for Showdown pools (classic-only mechanism); Showdown stacking is handled entirely by the sd-* flags below. Evidence source: HANDOFF_showdown_lineupstudy_findings_2026-09-28.md + HANDOFF_showdown_construction_detail_2026-09-28.md, 142 real DK Showdown contests / 14.9M entries. sd-require-cpt-qb is Supported and hard in BOTH contest types (a WR/TE captain with no own-team QB in FLEX: -7.6 cash pts SE, -7.7 big, 0.60-0.69x return). The other three sd-* weights are lighter here than in showdown_gpp because the underlying evidence is weaker in single-entry: sd-qb-partner-bonus reflects RB partner being only Weak-to-Supported in SE (TE partner is Supported at +8.5, RB is Weak at +4.9-9.1 with a CI spanning 0 in the projection-controlled re-check) vs both Supported in big; sd-cheap-tier-penalty reflects the $600-1k tier being Weak-to-Supported in SE (CI touches 0 on cash lift, only the top-1% cut clears 0) vs Supported in big; sd-stack-cap/-penalty reflects the QB stack-depth-at-2 finding being Weak-to-Supported in both, kept equal. lambda 0 is Confirmed (chalk tilt is Not supported once tested against OUR modeled pre-lock ownership, not just realized/hindsight ownership -- see the lineupstudy doc's Task 1 replay). sd-exclude-cpt-positions/sd-k-cpt-penalty were ADDED 2026-09-29: the first version of this preset had no lever touching DST/K captaincy at all, and a 100-lineup sanity build on a real slate landed 21% of captains on K/DST despite Rule 3 (DST captain Supported-bad in both contest types). DST is now hard-excluded from CPT; K gets a soft penalty since its evidence is only Weak. These sd-* weights are first-pass point-scale conversions of cash-lift/return findings, NOT a backtested-swept calibration like lambda's own grid (Session 10.5b) -- treat as a starting point to validate against real Wk4+ Showdown results, same as any other track-2 item. sd-heavy-side-cpt-penalty was ADDED 2026-09-29 (SHOWDOWN_RULES.md rule 7; WK3_CONSTRUCTION_RULE_AUDIT.md §2 flagged it as the one Showdown rule whose evidence qualified for a soft term but had none): a 4-2 split with the captain's own team on the heavy side is -1.2 to -1.6 cash pts, Supported but mild, n=142 real contests; 3-3 is best on average. Weight 0.5 is deliberately conservative because the existing sd-stack-cap=2/0.75 already charges a CPT-heavy 4-2 one unit (0.75, 3 same-team FLEX = 1 over the cap) for ANY captain, so the combined charge is 0.75+0.5=1.25, the bottom of the evidence range; 5-1 CPT-heavy pays 1.5+0.5=2.0. Same weight in both presets since the split finding was similar in both contest types. Same first-pass-calibration caveat. [UPDATED 2026-10-05, Wk4 construction review: sd-stack-cap-penalty 0.75 -> 0 and sd-heavy-side-cpt-penalty 0.5 -> 1.25 (SE: 3 FLEX -2.2, 4+ net ~-1.2; flat 1.25 at 3+). Projection-controlled history re-fit (analysis/wk4_construction_review/history_controlled_checks.py, 118 FC showdown contests, per-contest LPM cash ~ proj + own + CPT-team FLEX>=3 + >=4 + CPT position + 2K + DST): 3 same-team FLEX is -1.25 cash pooled (SE -2.2 passes, big -0.4 ns), but going to 4+ ADDS +1.27 back (passes, 4/4 seasons) -- so the per-extra-player stack-cap charge (4 FLEX paid 2.0, 5 paid 2.75) was wrong-direction past the first unit. 2026 real DK slates Wk1-4 (6) agree on direction: 4+ same-team FLEX +7.6 controlled cash pts, 5/6 positive. Replaced by a single flat charge at 3+ via the heavy-side flag. See SHOWDOWN_RULES.md rule 7.]
